encoding: UTF-8 JSON; no duplicate keys, NaN, Infinity, booleans in numeric fields, links, extra files or trailing non-whitespace.
conditions: Array of exactly2 records in Laser_OFF,Laser_ON order.

condition_fields.condition: Literal condition for this array position.
condition_fields.feature_order: Unique strings,1..condition feature_count_upper_bound; each starts uuid_, UTF-8 length<=260. Preserve candidate-derived source first-appearance order.
condition_fields.training_rows: Unique integer 1-based post-pivot trial row IDs in their actual partition-return order, length public training_rows.
condition_fields.test_rows: Unique increasing integer 1-based post-pivot trial row IDs, length public test_rows.
condition_fields.partition: training_rows and test_rows disjoint and their sorted union exactly1..public trial_rows. Neither context nor tone is a predictor.
condition_fields.probability_randomised: Finite JSON numbers in[0,1], exactly one per test_rows entry, same order. Other probability is1-p; class is Randomised at p>=0.5, Regular otherwise.

public_rejection: Wrong keys/types/identity/order/counts/ranges/partition/nonfinite values or oversize => invalid_submission before any private reference body read.
scored_support_mismatch: A structurally valid but different actual feature_order, training_rows or test_rows compared with the source reconstruction is a complete cell support mismatch: primary cell error1 with explicit reason. Do not silently drop it or treat hidden expected row identity as a public parse rule.
not_required: fit counts or internal search journals
full_cohort_aggregation: Exactly17 committed session outcomes. Infrastructure failures are not scores; candidate failure or missing valid output is retained as a failure, never a successful all34 reconstruction.

json_literal_rules.probability_type: JSON integer or float; booleans rejected
